correctness.rationale: Pair-swap and pair-permutation symmetry reduce the true unique global Löwner solution to two positive precision parameters. Complete convex endpoint rounding proves that binary cuts and exceptional spreads dominate all real feasible potentials. An exact radius factorization establishes every spherical regime; orthogonal sharp contacts establish n=4; full nonnegative support-slack tables and explicit positive KKT multipliers establish n=6. Strict concavity yields uniqueness and exact counting includes special endpoints. Thirteen independent rational configurations checked.

In all even dimensions >=8 a strictly growing Lipschitz dual ball leaves its unique Löwner ellipsoid unchanged.
